services.desc: Captain Don Guinn has lived around Alabama's beautiful gulf coast since 1996 and has been navigating the waters of this area for many years. Captain Don has experience in dolphin cruises, parasailing, fishing charters, private cruises and has also worked as an offshore captain. He attended Purdue University, where he studied marine biology. Captain Don also worked as an intern at the marine fisheries lab and is knowledgeable about the local marine life. Join us for an unforgettable private dolphin cruise, family day, or sunset cruise. Experience a truly customized cruise with Don Guinn and Custom Cruises.
